newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Hotel stock stops Mauritius bourse index decline.
newsitem.headline: Hotel stock stops Mauritius bourse index decline.

text.p: Gains in hotel concern New Mauritius Hotels (NMH) on Wednesday reversed the recent decline in the Stock Exchange of Mauritius index Semdex.
Brokers said Semdex gained 0.77 points to 379.22. Turnover rose to 10.67 million rupees on 480,202 shares from 4.39 million rupees on 138,972 shares on Monday.
New Mauritius Hotels rose 60 cents to 37 rupees on 113,335 shares, Grand Baie Hotel was stable at 47.20 on 1,000 shares and Sun Resorts was unchanged at 48.50 but was not traded.
"There has been buying interest in NMH from foreign investors during to-day's trading session," one broker said.
Brokers said that investors were in a cautious mood ahead of the Indian Ocean island's state budget on Monday.
In the banking sector, Mauritius Commercial Bank lost 50 cents to 87 rupees on 17,550 shares and State Bank of Mauritius (SBM) fell 10 cents to 11.60 rupees on 222,114 shares.
Insurance-based Mauritius Union Assurance (MUA) gained 10 cents to 29.60 rupees on 9,800 shares and British American Insurance (BAI) eased 10 cents to 8.30 rupees on 638 shares.
Industry stocks Mauritius Oil Refineries (MOR) fell 20 cents to 11.40 rupees on 30,649 shares and Gamma Civic remained at 18 rupees on 10,000 shares.
Sugar-based Mon Tresor Mon Desert was unchanged to 39.20 rupees on 50 shares.
In the commerce sector, Rogers fell 50 cents to 98 on 5,350 shares and Ireland Blyth Ltd edged 40 cents to 15.90 on 2,120 shares. Shell was 1.20 higher at 21.70 on 16,934 shares.
Air Mauritius was unchanged to 39 on 830 shares.
